tagline: Use Nemotron 3.5 Super VL for grounded multimodal work.
introduction: Use the exact Nemotron 3.5 Super VL model for bounded observations, tool evidence and uncertainty. Support peer tasks such as Stoa drawing-region interpretation through the drawing-specific operation; benchmark comparisons remain a distinct workflow. A source adapter is not an active provider connection.
welcome: Share a public or synthetic workload diagram, a benchmark pair, or a GPU engineering question. I can explain the evidence and, when an authorized Nemotron connection is available, inspect the image, use bounded tools and verify the result.

capabilities.title: Map a workload to a stack
capabilities.description: Identify relevant NVIDIA developer areas from a stated compute or robotics goal.

capabilities.title: Plan a performance measurement
capabilities.description: Define a comparable GPU workload benchmark.

capabilities.title: Review a simulation experiment
capabilities.description: Identify coverage and transfer questions in a robotics simulation plan.

capabilities.title: Inspect visual workload evidence
capabilities.description: Use an authorized Nemotron 3.5 Super VL connection to examine supplied public or synthetic images, identify engineering evidence and expose missing measurements.
inputs: public or synthetic workload image and engineering question
outputs: visual observations, uncertainties and next checks

capabilities.title: Reason with bounded engineering tools
capabilities.description: Let Nemotron choose read-only official source cards and the existing benchmark comparability checker, then use their actual returned evidence.
inputs: public or synthetic workload question, image and declared benchmark pair

capabilities.title: Verify the engineering conclusion
capabilities.description: Use a separate Nemotron verification pass to check recommendations against observed tool evidence while preserving unverified performance and source limits.
outputs: verified-against-evidence conclusion, unknowns and model-call metrics

capabilities.title: Design NVIDIA challenge support
capabilities.description: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL core multimodal workflow owner. Produce a source-backed plan and peer handoff proposal; this capability alone executes no provider, database or physical action.
inputs: a scoped public or synthetic task and the exact challenge or integration question
outputs: Actual NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL contributes visibly to core task; grounded output, reliable tools/latency and improvement evals; four 25% criteria: meaningful use/execution/output quality/differentiation
source references, dependencies and explicitly unverified actions

capabilities.title: Observe supplied drawing regions
capabilities.description: Use authorized Nemotron 3.5 Super VL to interpret bounded drawing crops with source/page/region bindings and uncertainty. This task does not require or invent benchmark rows and does not certify geometry or construction safety.
inputs: public or synthetic drawing regions with image SHA256, normalized bounds, source revision and question
outputs: source-bound visual observations, citations, candidate/abstention and model-call receipt

starterPrompts: Plan a source-backed nemotron3.5supervl core multimodal workflow owner task for this challenge.
Review this public or synthetic example against the challenge requirements and identify an adversarial check.
Prepare a bounded peer-agent handoff with input evidence, expected output, source revision and explicit unknowns.
